name: The Revenge Of The Forgotten Son
original_name: The Revenge Of The Forgotten Son
overview: The Olmedo family adopts two sons: Diego and Mario. However, Mario betrays Diego, deceiving the entire family by making them believe that Diego has poisoned him, when in reality it was the other way around. As a result, Diego loses his life. But fate grants him a second chance: to return ten years in the past.
